lastCompletedStory.title: Auto-chaining: in auto mode, flip active:true after branch and auto-dispatch ship on review CLEAN

nextStoryContext: US-005 added autoShipFn (RunSupervisorOptions) and flipActiveFn/autoShipFn (RunSidecarLoopOptions) to loop.ts. The sidecar reads planApproval once at startup (src/commands/sidecar.ts, same read-once point as mergeMode). Auto mode wires makeFlipActiveFn + makeAutoShipFn; operator mode leaves both undefined (conditional-injection pattern mirrors runMergeWatchFn). The auto-chain test file lives at test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts (8 tests). The flipActiveFn triggers via the sidecar loop after supervisor completes and hasPendingStories() returns true; autoShipFn triggers in runSupervisor review branch when verdict === 'CLEAN'. Both deps are threaded: autoShipFn via supervisorOpts mutation in runSidecarLoop, flipActiveFn lives only in runSidecarLoop. Production makeAutoShipFn sends '/cam-ship Enter' to orchestrator pane via tmux send-keys (reusing buildWorkerReportSendKeysArgv). Production makeFlipActiveFn writes active:true to .claude/cam-loop.local.md preserving other fields.
